description: This Java class 'TbDefaultDDFFileValidator' implements the 'DDFFileValidator' interface to validate DDF files against embedded LWM2M schemas, supporting versions 1.0 and 1.1. It includes methods for schema validation, schema loading, and security configurations to prevent XXE attacks.

classes.name: TbDefaultDDFFileValidator
classes.description: A validator class for DDF files that uses embedded LWM2M schemas for validation, supporting versions 1.0 and 1.1.

methods.name: TbDefaultDDFFileValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with LWM2M version 1.1 schema by default.

methods.name: TbDefaultDDFFileValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with a specific LWM2M version schema.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a DOM Node representing a DDF XML file.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an XML Source against the embedded LWM2M schema.

methods.name: getEmbeddedLwM2mSchema
methods.description: Loads and returns the embedded LWM2M schema based on the current version.

methods.name: createSchemaFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a secure SchemaFactory instance to prevent XXE attacks.
